challenge.scenario: An internal message is inserted by user who already left participant list.
challenge.finding: Their author read update might reactivate read or leave stale message that falsely appears accepted.
challenge.resolution: Verify left_at is null filter plus OFFICE_PRIVATE_AUTHOR_PARTICIPANT_REQUIRED on no updated row.

challenge.scenario: A client forges the author_id of an unrelated participant through privileged worker.
challenge.finding: A valid participant read marker could be updated for another user, compromising audit.
challenge.resolution: Retain database tenant/user matching and require separate runtime service_role actor binding evidence before DONE.

challenge.scenario: The inserted message belongs to another tenant even though thread_id resembles a valid private conversation.
challenge.finding: Cross-tenant last_read_at of matching UUID could be changed.
challenge.resolution: Require both new.instance_id and new.thread_id in thread lookup and participant update.

challenge.scenario: An older queued message is inserted after a newer read marker.
challenge.finding: last_read_at could move backwards, changing unread flags.
challenge.resolution: Retain CASE protecting last_read_at whenever it is newer than created_at.

challenge.scenario: A customer message has internal kind but thread type customer.
challenge.finding: Private read-state trigger may update unrelated support participant.
challenge.resolution: Verify internal_private/internal_group conversation_type check before update.

challenge.scenario: Trigger function becomes callable to authenticated clients due to inherited default EXECUTE.
challenge.finding: Untrusted roles could invoke helper or cause unauthorized read marker mutation.
challenge.resolution: Retain canonical revoke and confirm runtime pg_catalog effective privileges in disposable proof.

challenge.scenario: A newer 0053+ migration is added and old F5 test pins 0052 as final entry.
challenge.finding: Valid future append-only release is wrongly blocked by stale test.
challenge.resolution: Use relative ordered filename assertion and open-ended migration count.

challenge.scenario: Manifest reports READY before direct clean database replay.
challenge.finding: Automated truth incorrectly claims completed private read-state support.
challenge.resolution: Require snapshot-reviewed, proofContractSha256 null and explicit missing 0053+ obligations.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: After 0050 participant-aware private/group Office threads and 0051 assignee/private leave hardening, the canonical 20260908023500 author-read sync SQL is absent from Fresh Install. New internal messages must only update their legitimate active author participant last_read_at; nonparticipants and previously left members must be rejected, never silently reactivated or granted read. This unit appends canonical source, does not execute on real DB.
